_description: Player-facing 'Who's Who' cheat sheet, shown in the web companion sidebar. Maintained by the Bookkeeper: add a character when the party meets or learns of them; update note/disposition as things change. PLAYER-VISIBLE — never put secrets in name/disposition/note. Entries with known_to_party=false are hidden by the server (use to pre-stage reveals). disposition: friend | enemy | unknown.

characters.name: Gundren Rockseeker
characters.note: The dwarf who hired you. Kidnapped by goblins — he's being held at Cragmaw Castle.

characters.name: Sildar Hallwinter
characters.note: Soldier you rescued from the goblin cave. Back in Phandalin, working his contacts to find Cragmaw Castle.

characters.name: Toblen Stonehill
characters.note: Friendly innkeeper of the Stonehill Inn. Calls everyone 'friend.' Makes the stew.

characters.name: Trilena Stonehill
characters.note: Toblen's wife. Runs the kitchen — and once chased a Redbrand out with a soup ladle.

characters.name: Yark
characters.note: Goblin who joined your party! Guiding you to Cragmaw Castle in exchange for food and protection.

characters.name: Black Pearl
characters.note: Mira's wolf! Rescued from a goblin patrol with kind words and cooked rabbit. Gray coat, big appetite.

characters.name: The Black Spider
characters.note: The hidden villain. A dark elf nobody has seen. He ordered Gundren's kidnapping and wants the magic forge.

characters.name: The Redbrands
characters.note: Bullies in red cloaks who push Phandalin around. Based at the ruined manor on the edge of town.

characters.name: Klarg
characters.note: Bugbear boss of the goblin hideout. You slipped past him — he's still out there.

characters.name: Grib
characters.note: Goblin prisoner captured outside Cragmaw Castle. He works inside the castle — and he talks a LOT when scared.
